answer.reason: NEH 11:17 says he was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, which goes beyond the summary, while the other verses only list him or restate his lineage.

clauses.english: was the principal one to begin the thanksgiving in prayer
clauses.quote: was the principal to begin the thanksgiving in prayer

doubts: NEH 12:25 (porter) and 1CH 9:15 may concern different men named Mattaniah; the porter role is already in the disambiguation, so it is not repeated.
NEH 12:8 names a Mattaniah over the thanksgiving, which may be the same man; it is not cited.
